extracted.intended_audience: prospective Ford Fellowship applicants and academic institutions (graduate students, postdocs, early-career academics) interested in faculty careers
extracted.subtask_description: Information and selection expectations for the Ford Foundation Fellowships administered by the National Academies, describing program goals, applicant qualities sought, and the kinds of support offered to fellows across career stages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Increase diversity of college and university faculties
rubrics_metrics.description: The Ford Foundation Fellowships were designed to increase the diversity of the nation's college and university faculties by increasing their ethnic and racial diversity, maximizing the educational benefits of diversity, and increasing the number of professors who use diversity as a resource for enriching the education of all students.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is the program's central goal and framing: selection and program activities should align with enhancing ethnic and racial diversity and harnessing diversity to improve education for all students.

rubrics_metrics.name: Demonstrated superior academic achievement
rubrics_metrics.description: Support was provided for individuals who demonstrated superior academic achievement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Academic record and accomplishments are a core evaluation factor; applicants are expected to show evidence of high academic performance and scholarship.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commitment to a career in teaching and research at the college or university level
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants were expected to have committed to a career in teaching and research at the college or university level.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection favors candidates with clear long-term plans and demonstrated commitment to academic careers (both teaching and research) rather than short-term or non-academic career intentions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promise of future achievement as scholars and teachers
rubrics_metrics.description: Candidates should have shown promise of future achievement as scholars and teachers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewers assess potential for future scholarly productivity and teaching excellence — evidence can include research trajectory, letters of recommendation, teaching experience, and stated plans.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of diversity as a resource to enrich education
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants were expected to have used or plan to use diversity as a resource for enriching the education of all students.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection gives weight to demonstrated or proposed efforts that incorporate diversity into pedagogy, curricula, mentoring, or research to enhance learning outcomes for diverse student populations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support across career stages and professional development
rubrics_metrics.description: The fellowships spanned multiple stages of an academic career and provided mentorship, professional development, and an expansive alumni network enabling peer support and community building.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program design and selection consider fit with offerings such as mentorship and professional development; fellows are expected to engage with alumni networks and benefit from career-stage-appropriate support.
